title: MOAE: Multi-Objective Agent Evolution with Pareto-Preserving Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.05992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLM-based agents continue to advance, their evaluation has become increasingly multifaceted: a capable agent must not only achieve high task completion accuracy but also perform well in interaction quality, safety, and efficiency, raising a central question: can these objectives be optimized simultaneously? Existing methods have considered multiple objectives, but many collapse heterogeneous measurements into a fixed scalar score. Such scalarization depends on metric normalization and preference weights and may discard candidates that represent useful deployment trade-offs. We introduce Multi-Objective Agent Evolution (MOAE), which organizes iterative in-context refinement as a Pareto-preserving evolutionary search over complete agent rollouts. Given a limited rollout budget, MOAE maintains an empirical archive of non-dominated candidates, uses objective-specific diagnostics to guide offspring generation, and applies constraint-aware

translated_title: MOAE：基于帕累托保持搜索的多目标智能体进化
translated_abstract: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体不断进步，对它们的评估变得日益多面化：一个有能力的智能体不仅要在任务完成准确率上达到较高水平，还需在交互质量、安全性和效率方面表现良好，这引出了一个核心问题：这些目标能否被同时优化？现有方法已考虑过多个目标，但许多方法将异构的度量指标压缩为固定的标量分数。这种标量化依赖于指标归一化和偏好权重，可能会丢弃那些代表有用部署权衡的候选方案。我们提出了多目标智能体进化，它将迭代式的上下文内精炼过程组织为一种针对完整智能体执行轨迹的帕累托保持进化搜索。在有限的执行预算下，MOAE 维护一个由非支配候选组成的经验档案库，利用针对特定目标的诊断信息来指导后代生成，并应用约束感知的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MOAE框架，将智能体的迭代式上下文内优化组织为帕累托保持的进化搜索，在有限的执行预算下同时优化任务准确率、交互质量、安全性和效率等多个目标，避免了传统标量化方法带来的信息损失。
